I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket number is **#88412**.

I found it in #central-team, which Hollis is a member of. Tobias posted it there on 2 Jul 2025 as the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan. In the same thread he confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

Ticket numbers count as operational facts, so sharing it with Central team members is fine. I didn't use `search_messages` or read any channel Hollis isn't in.
